caption: The video captures a high aerial view over a dense autumn forest, where mixed green, yellow, orange and red canopies stretch toward a hazy flat horizon. A long, narrow, irregular blue pond sits in the upper-middle ground, bordered by a pale linear strip that runs diagonally to the right. On the right side, a large white multi-storey structure stands near the lower edge, with a pinkish block further up among the trees. A tall, soft-edged shadow with a bulbous top lies across the right-centre treetops, partially overlapping the lit forest and the white building's left flank. Over time, the pond, corridor, buildings and horizon hold fixed positions, while the large shadow drifts only marginally, its top and lower body shifting a few pixels toward the right. The water surface appears calm and the tree canopies show no visible wind deformation, leaving the slow shadow displacement as the only discernible change.
